rewrites.//: SPA fallback for client-side routes. It must NOT swallow /static/ - that catch-all used to match everything except /api/, so a request for a hashed bundle from a previous deploy returned index.html with a 200 and Content-Type: text/html. The browser then parsed HTML as JavaScript, threw 'Unexpected token <', and rendered a blank page. Anyone holding a cached index.html after a deploy got a dead app with no useful error. A missing asset must 404 honestly.
